race.comment: PIERATA'S GEM (8) has been handy enough on straightening but just lacked a killer blow at all three runs this prep, each time in Sydney Saturday grade. Takes a step back today and is cherry ripe. Looks a big danger although no placings from four runs on a heavy track is a slight concern - needs an upgrade. COBRA CLUB (4) was a big all-the-way winner two back at the Illawarra Grange circuit. Not too far away at Randwick last time which is decent form for a race like this. Another who will appreciate a track upgrade. ANDRON (10) didn't threaten last time out when fresh from an 11-month lay-off at Newcastle. Can improve sharply with that run under the belt over a bit more ground. RILEYCAT (9) finished just over a length away in a blanket finish over 1250m here recently. Looking for today's trip at the third run back. THREE ARROWS (5) is deep into the prep and still racing well. Will enjoy a nice trail and should be hard to hold out.
